prompt: Our port operations team needs a self-contained, single-file web dashboard called 'harbor-ops' to replace our Excel-based cargo tracking system. The dashboard needs to show four KPI summary cards at the top (total vessels, cargo awaiting clearance in TEUs, vessels departed today, and average dwell time), a vessel status table that can be filtered by tabs (All / In Port / Departed) with columns for vessel name, flag, cargo type, TEUs, berth, status, and ETA/ETD — use colored status indicators for In Port, Clearing, Delayed, and Departed states — and a cargo manifest breakdown section showing container, bulk, liquid, and vehicle cargo counts with visual indicators. Use the sample data from harbor-ops-requirements.md for the hardcoded values. The final deliverable must be a single file called bundle.html that can be dropped into any browser with no internet connection and no build step. The design should feel like a professional maritime control room tool — data-dense and neutral-toned.
